iti75:1.1: (Tik. III.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti75:2.1: Tayo-me bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. Katame tayo? Avuṭṭhikasamo padesavassī sabbatthābhivassī. --
iti75:3.1: Kathañca bhikkhave puggalo avuṭṭhikasamo hoti? Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabbesaññeva na dātā hoti, samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇiddhikavanibbakayācakānaṃ annaṃ pānam vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ, evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo avuṭṭhikasamo hoti. --
iti75:4.1: Kathañca bhikkhave puggalo padesavassī hoti? Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ekaccānaṃ dātā hoti, ekaccānaṃ na dātā hoti, samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇiddhikavanibbakayācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ, evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo padesavassī hoti. --
iti75:5.1: Kathañca bhikkhave puggalo sabbatthābhivassī hoti? Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabbesaṃ deti, samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇiddhikavanibbakayācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ, evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo sabbatthābhivassī hoti. -- Ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin-ti. -- Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti75:6.1: Na samaṇe na brāhmaṇe na kapaṇiddhike na vanibbake | laddhāna saṃvibhājeti annaṃ pānañca bhojanaṃ | taṃ ve avuṭṭhikasamo ti āhu naṃ purisādhamaṃ ||
iti75:7.1: Ekaccānaṃ na dadāti ekaccānaṃ pavecchati | taṃ ve padesavassīti āhu medhāvino janā ||
iti75:8.1: Subhikkhavāco puriso sabbabhūtānukampako | āmodamāno pakireti detha dethā-ti bhāsati ||
iti75:9.1: Yathāpi megho thanayitvā gajjayitvā pavassati | thalaṃ ninnañca pūreti abhisandanto vārinā |
iti75:10.1: evam-eva idh-ekacco puggalo hoti tādiso || Dhammena saṃharitvāna uṭṭhānādhigataṃ dhanaṃ | tappeti annapānena sammā satte vanibbake ti ||
iti75:11.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||6||
